value.rationale: It gives a complete exact family of natural parity-support counts and a sharp sublinear power-law for a classical Fibonacci partition function. The zero-density law distinguishes sparse odd counts from the ubiquitous strictly positive representation counts, which existing positive moment theorems cannot provide. The finite automaton is a structural certificate rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
